comment: Known production advisories, signed off with a review deadline. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails CI on any high/critical advisory missing here, on any entry audit no longer reports, and on a critical entry past reviewBy. `reviewBy: null` means informational only (moderate/low) — no deadline, never gating.

advisories.reason: IP spoofing via an IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnet. It sits under the express `trust proxy` path, so a forged X-Forwarded-For can be believed by rate limiting and audit logging; fixAvailable is a patch bump of proxy-addr itself, and that upgrade must land before anything else in the express tree.
DoS via trailing bytes after a compressed request body. Remediation is a patch bump of body-parser inside the express dependency tree, tracked separately from this gate.
DoS via crafted multipart field names. Reached through @nestjs/platform-express; remediation is a patch/minor bump of multer, tracked separately.
DoS via a file descriptor leak on aborted uploads. Same multer bump as GHSA-wc9g-mqfw-jrwm.
DoS via an oversized array index in multipart field names. Same multer bump as GHSA-wc9g-mqfw-jrwm.
DoS via a pending asynchronous fileFilter after request teardown. Same multer bump as GHSA-wc9g-mqfw-jrwm.
DoS via orphaned disk writes on aborted uploads. Goes away with the same multer bump as the high advisories; informational only, so no deadline.
File size limit bypass via an async fileFilter race. Goes away with the same multer bump; informational only.
AbortSignal cancellation bypass allows post-timeout filesystem traversal. Only reachable through typeorm, whose fixAvailable is a MAJOR upgrade (0.3.x -> 1.x); not fixable without that migration.
DoS via globparts amplification. Reached through glob under typeorm; same MAJOR typeorm upgrade.
qs.stringify with arrayFormat 'comma' throws an uncaught TypeError on array elements with a non-callable toString. Remediation is a patch bump of qs, tracked separately.
